title: Solar String Open-Circuit Voltage Check
description: Measure open-circuit DC voltage (Voc) on parallel PV strings and confirm the strings match within tolerance.

steps.title: Safety And Setup
steps.instruction: SAFETY: PV strings produce hazardous DC voltage in daylight and cannot be switched off. Confirm the meter and leads are DC-rated for the string voltage (up to 1000 V). Never open a connector under load - only measure Voc at an open (disconnected) string. Watch polarity.
steps.note_prompt: Record module model, count per string, and expected Voc.

steps.title: Measure String A Voc
steps.instruction: With String A open-circuited, set the meter to DC voltage and measure across the string leads. Capture the open-circuit voltage.

acceptance.description: Sanity band up to the 1000 V system limit; refine to expected string Voc.

steps.title: Measure String B Voc
steps.instruction: Measure the open-circuit voltage of a matching parallel String B under the same irradiance. Capture the reading. Matching strings should agree within about 5%; a larger gap suggests a bad module, connector, or bypass diode.

acceptance.description: String B Voc must be within 5% of String A under the same conditions.

steps.note_prompt: Note any string that is low.

steps.title: Record Result
steps.instruction: Document the comparison. Investigate mismatched strings before commissioning or reconnecting to the inverter.
